payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the proposed models against baseline models such as LSTM and transformer, indicating improvements in BLEU scores across various datasets.

claims.text: The models with ReWE outperformed the LSTM and transformer baselines consistently across different datasets.
In the eu-en dataset, ReWE+ReSE improved results by $+5.15$ BLEU pp over the corresponding baselines.
The transformer performed poorly compared to the LSTM on the eu-en dataset, indicating variability in baseline performance.
The proposed regularization techniques improved performance in low-resource cases compared to baseline models.
